discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_5/section_5.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_5/section_5.x/cis_5.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Member Server only (from the upstream task name).

No runnable check (primary writes mix win_regedit, win_service); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "5.2 | PATCH | Ensure Print Spooler (Spooler) is set to Disabled MS only | Member Server"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_5_2
    - not prelim_win19cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level2-memberserver
    - rule_5.2
    - patch
    - printer
    - NIST800-171_3.4.2
    - NIST800-171_3.4.6
    - NIST800-171_3.4.7
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-6
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-7
  notify: Change_Requires_Reboot
  block:
    - name: "5.2 | PATCH | Ensure Print Spooler (Spooler) is set to Disabled MS only | Member Server | Check to see if Spooler service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: Spooler
      check_mode: false
      register: discovered_5_2_spooler_service_info

    - name: "5.2 | PATCH | Ensure Print Spooler (Spooler) is set to Disabled MS only | Member Server | RegEdit"
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Spooler
        name: Start
        data: 4
        type: dword

    - name: "5.2 | PATCH | Ensure Print Spooler (Spooler) is set to Disabled MS only | Member Server | Service"
      when: discovered_5_2_spooler_service_info.exists
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: Spooler
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped
